findings.title: Pool filter does not narrow results
findings.severity_rationale: Users searching for pool stays are shown non-pool properties, causing incorrect booking choices.
findings.priority_rationale: Core discovery filter is misleading in primary browse journey.
findings.impact: Reduced trust in search filters and higher risk of wrong property selection.
findings.expected: Only properties with pool amenities remain visible
findings.actual: Properties labelled 'No swimming pool' remain visible after filter activation
findings.comparison: Filter control state changed to pressed and backend query used pool=true, but card set did not match
possible_causes: Filter state not applied when rendering card subset
Backend pool parameter ignored or mismatched with UI attributes
findings.recommendation: Align pool filter logic with displayed amenity flag and add assertion tests for negative amenities.

findings.title: The Anda card secondary CTA routes to Serena Villas
findings.severity_rationale: User intent is redirected to a different property from the selected card.
findings.priority_rationale: Direct conversion CTA misroutes on a top card in primary browsing surface.
findings.impact: Users may book the wrong listing and lose confidence in navigation integrity.
steps: Observe destination page title and URL
findings.expected: CTA destination matches The Anda card identity
findings.expected_basis: Card title link and CTA should represent same listing
findings.comparison: The Anda title link itself routes correctly to /#/hotel/the-anda
possible_causes: Incorrect href binding for first card CTA template
findings.recommendation: Bind CTA target from current card record and add link-consistency test per card.
